title.zh: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business
title.en: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business

current_state.zh: 纽约总检察长 Letitia James 在曼哈顿法院起诉 Polymarket，指控其无证赌博，寻求禁令、三倍收益赔偿及每份体育合约 10 万美元罚款。
current_state.en: New York Attorney General Letitia James sued Polymarket in Manhattan court, alleging unlicensed gambling and seeking an injunction, treble damages, and $100,000 per sports contract.

updates.title_zh: New York Sues Polymarket US Over Unlicensed Gambling
updates.title_en: New York Sues Polymarket US Over Unlicensed Gambling
updates.what_changed_zh: 纽约总检察长在曼哈顿法院起诉 Polymarket，具体寻求禁止该 CFTC 指定交易所在纽约运营、三倍收益赔偿，并按每份体育合约罚款 10 万美元。
updates.what_changed_en: The New York Attorney General sued Polymarket in Manhattan court, specifically seeking to bar the CFTC-designated exchange from operating in New York, triple its gains, and impose $100,000 per sports contract.
updates.current_state_zh: 纽约总检察长 Letitia James 在曼哈顿法院起诉 Polymarket，指控其无证赌博，寻求禁令、三倍收益赔偿及每份体育合约 10 万美元罚款。
updates.current_state_en: New York Attorney General Letitia James sued Polymarket in Manhattan court, alleging unlicensed gambling and seeking an injunction, treble damages, and $100,000 per sports contract.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: New York Attorney General Letitia James sued Polymarket US in Manhattan court, seeking to bar the CFTC-designated exchange from operating in the state, triple its gains, and levy $100,000 per sports contract offered, on grounds of unlicensed gambling.
updates.detailed_summary_en: New York Attorney General Letitia James sued Polymarket US in Manhattan court, seeking to bar the CFTC-designated exchange from operating in the state, triple its gains, and levy $100,000 per sports contract offered, on grounds of unlicensed gambling.
